title: Best AI Tools for Ad Creatives in 2026: 11 Compared
summary: The best AI tools for Facebook and Instagram ad creatives in 2026: 11 tools compared by job, free plan and price, checked on each maker's own pages.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI tool for ad creatives?


Start from the ad format you need, then check how true the tool keeps your real product, how it counts usage, and whether it should also launch the ads, in that order.


1.


### 1


Pick the format


Static images and carousels, UGC videos with a talking actor and short product videos are made best by different tools, so start from the format your account runs most.


2.


### 2


Keep the product true


An ad that changes the label, color or shape of what you sell costs trust, so test each tool on your own product photos before paying for a plan.


3.


### 3


Count the usage


Credits, generations and pricing by monthly ad spend run out in different ways, so price the number of ads you will test in a month, retries included.


4.


### 4


Decide where ads launch


Some tools stop at the creative files, while others push them into Meta or track how they performed, so decide whether you want one more dashboard or just better files.
